title: Platform Features
subtitle: Six scientifically grounded digital tools designed specifically for Indian farming workflows.

cropRec.title: AI Crop Recommendation
cropRec.desc: Analyzes 7 critical agronomic variables (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Soil pH, Temperature, Humidity, and Rainfall) through a trained Random Forest model. Evaluates regional suitability and outputs recommended sowing windows and limitation precautions.

weather.title: Agromet Weather Advisory
weather.desc: Delivers 5-day localized forecasts, precipitation probability, and actionable farming alerts customized for your crop stage (irrigation timings, pest scout warnings, spraying speed safety).

soil.title: Soil Health Analyzer
soil.desc: Translates complex Soil Health Card laboratory parameters into simple ratings (Low, Medium, High) with balanced chemical and organic amendment suggestions (compost, gypsum, lime).

mandi.title: APMC Mandi Price Tracker
mandi.desc: Tracks commodity market arrivals, minimum, maximum, and modal benchmark rates across Indian districts with APMC comparison tools.

calendar.title: Dynamic Crop Calendar
calendar.desc: Provides a stage-by-stage farming timeline (Land Prep, Sowing, Crown Root Irrigation, Top Dressing, Weeding, Harvesting) with interactive task completion tracking.

aiChat.title: Krishi AI Assistant
aiChat.desc: A multilingual question-and-answer assistant built on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using verified ICAR publications with strict safety disclaimers against unverified chemicals.
